title: Counterexamples to EFX for Submodular and Subadditive Valuations
abstract: arXiv:2605.06451v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The existence of EFX allocations is a fundamental question in fair division. In this paper, we construct a three-agent, eight-good instance with monotone subadditive valuations such that no allocation satisfies $\alpha$-EFX for any $\alpha > \frac{1}{\sqrt[6]{2}} \approx 0.89$. We also provide a closely related three-agent, eight-good instance with submodular (in fact weighted coverage) valuations for which no EFX allocation exists.   A key feature of our construction is its symmetry: the agents' valuations are identical up to a relabeling of the goods. Thus, EFX can fail even when agents differ only in how the goods are labeled. This symmetry makes the counterexamples compact and human-verifiable, yielding simple combinatorial obstructions to the existence of EFX.

translated_title: 次模与次可加估值下EFX的反例
translated_abstract: EFX分配的存在性是公平划分中的一个基本问题。在本文中，我们构造了一个三智能体、八物品的实例，其估值是单调次可加的，使得不存在任何满足α-EFX的分配，其中α > 1/⁶√2 ≈ 0.89。我们还提供了一个密切相关的三智能体、八物品实例，其估值是次模的（实际上是加权覆盖函数），且不存在EFX分配。我们构造的一个关键特征是其对称性：各智能体的估值在物品重新标记的意义上是完全相同的。因此，即使智能体仅在物品的标记方式上存在差异，EFX也可能失效。这种对称性使得这些反例紧凑且可由人工验证，为EFX分配的存在性提供了简单的组合性障碍。
tldr: 本文通过对称的三智能体、八物品反例，证明即使在次模估值下也不存在EFX分配，且在次可加估值下任何α-EFX近似比率都不可能超过约0.89。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs symmetric three-agent, eight-good instances showing that EFX allocations do not exist even under submodular valuations, and that no allocation is α-EFX for any α > 0.89 under subadditive valuations.
